title: Settings
lead: Generation provider, scan schedule, thresholds, daily caps, and limits.

provider.title: Production system
provider.downNote: Jobs, samples and scans wait until it runs again.
provider.fakeNote: Nothing is sent to the provider; no paid request is made.
provider.notConfiguredNote: The provider key is not set on the server, so no paid request can be made.
provider.unknown: The status could not be read.
provider.note: The API key is set on the server. It is never shown here.
provider.outOfCredits: The provider refused the last paid request: no credits. Top up the account; customers' jobs stop until then.
provider.afterTopUp: After the top-up, press "Retry job" on a job that stopped for it; once that job gets through, new jobs run again.

caps.title: Daily caps
caps.note: When a cap is reached, the remaining candidates wait until the next day. These steps spend no credits; the cap only limits AI usage.

scanning.title: Scanning
scanning.searchesPlaceholder: One hashtag per line, e.g. skincare
scanning.searchesNote: A YouTube Shorts scan reads these hashtag pages.
scanning.topAdsIndustryNote: Beauty categories are verified from card labels; ads without a matching label are excluded.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.note: A candidate scoring above the threshold becomes a template automatically; the rest wait in the Inbox.

applyNote: Scan settings apply from the next scan. Limits and safety apply as soon as you save.

error.threshold: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
error.failed: Settings were not saved. Try again.
error.fix: Nothing was saved. A field above is marked: fix it and save again.
error.duplicate: Each scan time must be different.
error.seconds: Enter a whole number from 1 to 600.
error.order: The maximum length must not be below the minimum length.
error.searches: Use at most {max} hashtags of up to 100 characters: letters, numbers and _ only.
error.searchesRequired: Add at least one hashtag, or turn YouTube Shorts off.
error.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
error.percent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
error.topAdsFilter: Choose an industry, a country code and 7, 30 or 180 days.
error.country: Use a two-letter country code, like US or GB.
error.shortsNeedsHashtag: YouTube Shorts needs a hashtag: add one under Shorts hashtags, or turn it off.

limits.title: Limits and safety
limits.jobsAtOnce: Jobs per user at the same time
limits.ownVideos: Own videos per user per day
limits.note: The daily spending limit counts what the generation provider charges in one day. While generation is paused, no new job starts and customers see: Generation is paused for a short time.

swap.title: Person swap
swap.featureNote: While this is on, customers see the person-swap pages and can start a person-swap job.
swap.reviewNote: While this is on, every person-swap job waits until an admin has looked at its photos and approved them.
swap.fakeNote: Nothing is sent to a provider; no person-swap request is paid.
swap.notConfiguredNote: This worker has no person-swap provider: a person-swap job would stop.

reviewOff.title: Switch off the look at photos?
reviewOff.body: Generation will start without anyone looking at the photos. A job that already waits still waits for its answer. This applies when you save changes.
